excluded.name: biblatex
excluded.reason: Confirmed broken: Tectonic's bundled biblatex.sty writes a .bcf format version that no real biber binary produces/expects (BCF version mismatch). No workaround exists. See docs/CONTRACT.md. natbib covers core's citation need instead; revisit if this is ever resolved upstream.

excluded.name: biber
excluded.reason: Same BCF mismatch as biblatex above -- biber itself doesn't work at all today, for anyone, independent of any bundling decision.

excluded.name: tikz/pgf
excluded.reason: Deliberate, debatable omission (Section 9.6's own framing): genuinely common in the target audience's work, but large. Ship without it, watch install counts once package telemetry exists (task 4.13), promote into core in a point release if the data says so.
